prOriginalConhecido.nota: Found via gh pr list by author leonorfmartins ("Dual writer: mode 3", branch dualwriter_mode3). Its headRefOid is e369f24665ec, the benchmark head; squash-merged as 67b74e1e8a. The mode3 file was deleted on 2025-03-01 (#101393) and folded into pkg/storage/legacysql/dualwrite/dualwriter.go.

tps.bug: Mode 3 legacy-storage write errors (create/update/delete/delete-collection) are no longer logged after moving to async goroutines; only a duration metric with an error flag is recorded.
tps.evidenciaOpus: In dualwriter_mode3.go the legacy writes moved into goroutines that only call recordLegacyDuration(err != nil, ...) (Create, Update, Delete, DeleteCollection); the previous log.Error calls for legacy failures were removed. Failures are still counted in metrics, so the effect is loss of error detail in logs, not a behaviour change.
tps.evidenciaAstra: The PR removes legacy-error logging; the replacement goroutines only pass error booleans to metrics in pkg/apiserver/rest/dualwriter_mode3.go:55-56,112-113,139-140,165-166. Those helpers only observe histograms (pkg/apiserver/rest/metrics.go:54-61), so failure counts remain observable but the actual error details are lost, impairing diagnosis.
